snippet.title: I Love My New Job- Midnight Myths
snippet.description:
So excited to be back playing indie horror games and what better way to start out than to play a Watchtower horror game
Special thanks to @MrCreepyPasta and GeneralDrowned for making this you guys rock

Play the game here: https://mrcreepypasta.itch.io/midnight-myths

Thank you so much for joining us on this wild ride - Until next time check out the links below to see the other wild stuff I'm up to!
